summary: Delete Managed Equipment Maintenance Log Attachment
description: Delete an attachment from a Managed Equipment Maintenance Log.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the managed equipment maintenance log.

parameters.name: attachment_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the managed equipment maintenance log attachment.

id.description: Unique identifier of this maintenance log attachment.

presentation_url.description: URL for the presentation-sized rendering of the attached file. Suitable for display in a viewer.

url.description: URL for downloading the original attached file at full resolution.

thumbnail_url.description: URL for a thumbnail-sized preview of the attached file. Suitable for list views. Null for non-thumbnailable extensions such as DOCX and XLSX, which already returned null. PDF and image attachments ...

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded attachment, including its file extension.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attached file, such as application/pdf or image/png.
